items.limitationEn: As a qualitative study with a small sample size (11 UK physiotherapists), the findings may not be broadly representative.

items.title: Predictive value of handgrip strength, calf circumference, and the SARC-F questionnaire for institutionalization and mortality after hip fracture – a real-world cohort study
items.summary: A real-world cohort study of 222 older adults found that a positive SARC-F questionnaire screen strongly predicted institutionalization (OR 8.20, 95% CI 2.34–28.7) and mortality (HR 3.00, 95% CI 1.11–8.07) one year after hip fracture, while handgrip strength and calf circumference did not show consistent association.
items.curatedReason: 在髋部骨折的老年患者中，SARC-F 阳性评分预示着更高的机构化入住率（OR 8.20）和死亡率（HR 3.00）。相比握力或小腿围，将 SARC-F 问卷纳入评估流程，能更早识别高风险患者并进行干预。
items.titleZh: 手握力、小腿围和 SARC-F 问卷对髋部骨折后机构化和死亡率的预测价值：一项真实世界队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 222 名老年髋部骨折患者的真实世界队列研究发现，SARC-F 问卷阳性筛查可强力预测髋部骨折后 1 年的机构化入住率（OR 8.20，95% CI 2.34–28.7）和死亡率（HR 3.00，95% CI 1.11–8.07），而手握力和小腿围未显示出一致关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: Among older adults with hip fracture, a positive SARC-F score strongly predicts higher rates of institutionalization (OR 8.20) and mortality (HR 3.00). Incorporate the SARC-F questionnaire into your assessment process; it appears more effective than handgrip strength or calf circumference for identifying high-risk patients for early intervention.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心队列研究，样本量相对有限（222 人），结果可能无法完全外推至其他人群或医疗环境。
items.limitationEn: This is a single-center cohort study with a relatively limited sample size (222 participants), so the results may not be fully generalizable to other populations or healthcare settings.

items.title: Empowering safer mobility behaviour for fall prevention in people with Parkinson's disease: A qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study involving physiotherapists, occupational therapists, and researchers identified empowerment as central to promoting safer mobility behavior for fall prevention in Parkinson's disease, emphasizing contextual, individualized, and collaborative approaches.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究强调了在帕金森病患者跌倒预防中，赋能患者采取更安全移动行为的重要性。它提示你需要采取更具背景化、个体化和协作性的方法，而不是仅专注于运动本身。
items.titleZh: 赋能帕金森病患者更安全的移动行为以预防跌倒：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对物理治疗师、职业治疗师和研究人员的定性研究发现，赋能是促进帕金森病患者安全移动行为以预防跌倒的核心，强调背景化、个体化和协作性方法。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study highlights the importance of empowering safer mobility behaviors for fall prevention in people with Parkinson's disease. It suggests you adopt a more contextual, individualized, and collaborative approach beyond just focusing on movement.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，结果可能受参与者主观体验影响，且外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study, and its findings may be influenced by participants' subjective experiences and have limited generalizability.

items.title: Longitudinal Trajectories and Risk Factors for Post-traumatic Chronic Pain and Pruritus Following Burn Injuries: a Prospective Multicenter Cohort Study
items.summary: A prospective multicenter cohort study elucidated the longitudinal trajectories and risk factors for post-traumatic chronic pain and pruritus following burn injuries, highlighting persistent physical and psychological sequelae.
items.curatedReason: 烧伤后的慢性疼痛和瘙痒远超急性期。这项前瞻性队列研究提示，你需要更关注烧伤患者的长期身心康复，特别是要识别并干预那些已知的风险因素。
items.titleZh: 烧伤后创伤后慢性疼痛和瘙痒的纵向轨迹和风险因素：一项前瞻性多中心队列研究。
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性多中心队列研究阐明了烧伤后创伤后慢性疼痛和瘙痒的纵向轨迹和风险因素，突出了持续存在的身体和心理后遗症。
items.curatedReasonEn: Chronic pain and pruritus after burn injuries persist far beyond the acute phase. This prospective cohort study suggests you should pay closer attention to the long-term physical and psychological recovery of burn patients, particularly by identifying and intervening in known risk factors.
items.limitation: 作为观察性队列研究，只能揭示相关性，无法确立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: As an observational cohort study, it can only reveal correlations, not establish causality.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Letter to Editor: Effects of a Teleexercise Movement-to-Music Intervention on Health Outcomes in Individuals With Mobility Disabilities: A Randomized Controlled Trial
items.summary: This letter to the editor discusses statistical reporting issues in a randomized controlled trial on the effects of a tele-exercise movement-to-music intervention for individuals with mobility disabilities.
items.curatedReason: 这封致编辑的信指出了一项远程音乐运动干预 RCT 在统计报告上的潜在问题。它提醒您，即使是高质量的远程康复研究，也需要审慎评估其统计数据的准确性，以免误读治疗效果。
items.titleZh: 致编辑的信：远程音乐运动干预对行动障碍个体健康结局影响的随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 这篇致编辑的信讨论了一项关于远程音乐运动干预对行动障碍个体健康结局影响的随机对照试验中，存在的统计报告问题。
items.curatedReasonEn: This letter to the editor highlights potential statistical reporting issues in a tele-exercise movement-to-music RCT. It reminds you that even high-quality telerehabilitation studies require careful evaluation of statistical accuracy to avoid misinterpreting treatment effects.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Comparison of short-foot and toe-curl exercises on movement control during single-leg landing after ACL reconstruction: An exploratory randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A multicenter exploratory RCT (N=38) found that short-foot exercise (SFE) led to earlier improvements in hip adduction excursion during single-leg landing compared to toe-curl exercise (TCE) in ACLR patients, with between-group difference of -6.30° (95% CI, -9.19 to -3.41; ES, -1.41) at 6 weeks.
items.curatedReason: ACL 重建术后患者的运动控制训练，短足运动（SFE）在改善额状面运动控制方面似乎优于趾卷曲运动（TCE），并且改善出现得更早。这提示你可以考虑将 SFE 优先整合到 ACLR 术后康复方案中。
items.titleZh: ACL 重建术后单腿落地运动控制中短足运动与趾卷曲运动的比较：一项探索性随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项多中心探索性 RCT（N=38）发现，ACL 重建术后患者在单腿落地时，短足运动（SFE）在改善髋关节内收偏移方面比趾卷曲运动（TCE）有更早的改善，6 周时组间差异为 -6.30°（95% CI, -9.19 至 -3.41；ES, -1.41）。
items.curatedReasonEn: For ACL reconstruction patients, short-foot exercise (SFE) appears superior to toe-curl exercise (TCE) in improving frontal-plane movement control, with earlier improvements noted. This suggests you might prioritize integrating SFE into ACLR post-operative rehabilitation protocols.
items.limitation: 这是一项探索性研究，样本量相对较小（38人），可能限制了结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: This is an exploratory study with a relatively small sample size (38 participants), which may limit the generalizability of the findings.
items.journal: Physical therapy in sport : official journal of the Association of Chartered Physiotherapists in Sports Medicine

items.title: Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency - Record 13,171 notifications completed as health workforce nears one million
items.summary: The 2025/26 AHPRA annual report highlights a record 13,171 notifications completed as Australia's health workforce nears one million. It notes improved responses to racism and discrimination, increased referrals to tribunals (295 practitioners, up 53.6%), and enhanced transparency with sexual misconduct findings now public. New expedited pathways for international practitioners also supported workforce growth.
items.curatedReason: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管机构 (AHPRA) 的年度报告显示，在医疗劳动力接近一百万的背景下，完成了创纪录数量的投诉通知，并加强了对种族主义和歧视的回应。作为澳大利亚的物理治疗师，这表明监管机构在持续改进其透明度和风险管理，关注专业行为和临床表现，因此你应密切关注其发布的指南和政策更新，确保执业合规性。
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管机构——随着医疗劳动力接近一百万，完成了创纪录的 13,171 份通知
items.summaryZh: 2025/26 年度 AHPRA 报告显示，在澳大利亚医疗劳动力接近一百万之际，完成了创纪录的 13,171 份通知。报告指出，对种族主义和歧视的回应有所改善，提交给法庭的案件有所增加（295 名从业者，增长 53.6%），并且通过公开性行为不当裁决提高了透明度。新的国际从业者快速通道也支持了劳动力增长。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA) annual report shows a record number of notifications completed amidst a health workforce nearing one million, along with an improved response to racism and discrimination. As a physical therapist in Australia, this indicates that the regulator is continuously improving its transparency and risk management, focusing on professional conduct and clinical performance. Therefore, you should closely follow its published guidelines and policy updates to ensure compliance in your practice.

items.title:
Impact of age and frailty on the effect of a multimodal individualized long-term intervention after stroke: the last-long trial
							| Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine
items.summary: A single-blinded RCT (n=301) found that a stroke coordinator-led, community-based intervention showed no overall functional benefit, but age modified the effect. Participants ≥80 years old were less likely to have a favorable mRS outcome (23.4% vs 57.0%, p=0.004) with intervention, while younger participants showed improved Trail Making Test B scores (-32.2 s, 95% CI -58.0 to -6.4, p=0.015).
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 表明，卒中后的长期多模式干预对不同年龄组有差异效应。80 岁以上患者可能不会从干预中获得整体功能改善，甚至有更差结果的倾向，而年轻患者在认知方面可能受益。你在为卒中患者制定长期康复计划时，应根据患者年龄调整干预策略，尤其对老年患者要重新评估方案的适用性。
items.titleZh: 年龄和衰弱对卒中后多模式个体化长期干预效果的影响：LAST-long 试验
items.summaryZh: 一项单盲随机对照试验（n=301）发现，一项由卒中协调员主导的社区干预措施没有显示出总体功能益处，但年龄改变了其效果。80 岁及以上参与者在干预后获得良好改良 Rankin 量表（mRS）结果的可能性较低（23.4% vs 57.0%，p=0.004），而年轻参与者在径迹追踪测试 B 中得分有所改善（-32.2 秒，95% CI -58.0 至 -6.4，p=0.015）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT indicates differential effects of long-term multimodal intervention after stroke across age groups. Patients over 80 years old may not experience overall functional benefit from the intervention, and may even trend toward worse outcomes, while younger patients might benefit cognitively. When developing long-term rehabilitation plans for stroke patients, you should tailor intervention strategies based on age, especially re-evaluating the suitability of plans for older patients.
items.limitation: 本研究主要关注卒中轻度症状的参与者，结果对外推至更严重的卒中患者可能存在局限性。
items.limitationEn: This study primarily focused on participants with mild stroke symptoms, limiting the generalizability of the findings to patients with more severe stroke.

items.title: How Should Practices Manage Credit Card Processing Fees?
items.summary: This article explains the complex rules for physical therapy practices regarding credit card processing fees, noting that Medicare prohibits passing these fees to beneficiaries. It details varying state laws (some strictly prohibit, others permit with limits) and credit card network rules (Visa and Mastercard permit with strict disclosure guidelines and notification requirements), advising practices to consult legal counsel.
items.curatedReason: 这篇文章详细阐述了物理治疗诊所能否将信用卡手续费转嫁给患者的复杂规定，特别指出 Medicare 不允许此操作，且各州法律和信用卡网络规则差异巨大。在你的执业中，务必熟悉你所在州和地区关于附加费的具体法律，并在执行前咨询法律顾问，以避免违规。
items.titleZh: 诊所如何管理信用卡手续费？
items.summaryZh: 本文解释了物理治疗诊所关于信用卡手续费的复杂规定，指出 Medicare 禁止将这些费用转嫁给受益人。文章详细阐述了各州法律（有些严格禁止，有些允许但有限制）和信用卡网络规则（Visa 和 Mastercard 允许，但有严格的披露准则和通知要求）的差异，建议诊所咨询法律顾问。
items.curatedReasonEn: This article details the complex regulations governing whether physical therapy clinics can pass credit card processing fees to patients, specifically noting that Medicare prohibits this and that state laws and credit card network rules vary widely. In your practice, you must be familiar with the specific laws regarding surcharges in your state and region, and consult legal counsel before implementation, to avoid non-compliance.

items.title: Weekly musculoskeletal pain beyond self-reported injury in Italian track-and-field athletes: a 23-week prospective cohort study
items.summary: A 23-week prospective cohort study (n=96) of Italian track-and-field athletes found that musculoskeletal pain was reported in 25.2% of athlete-weeks, but only 8.3% were athlete-labelled injuries. Two-thirds of pain-positive weeks (67.6%) were not labeled as injuries, highlighting that relying on self-reported injury significantly underestimates the symptom burden.
items.curatedReason: 这项前瞻性队列研究强调，仅依赖运动员自报伤病会遗漏大部分疼痛问题。在你的运动康复实践中，应采用基于症状和后果的监测工具，如 OSTRC 问卷，以便更全面地识别和管理运动员的健康问题，而不仅仅是等待他们自报“伤病”。
items.titleZh: 意大利田径运动员自报伤病之外的每周肌肉骨骼疼痛：一项为期 23 周的前瞻性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对意大利田径运动员的为期 23 周前瞻性队列研究（n=96）发现，25.2% 的运动员周报告有肌肉骨骼疼痛，但仅 8.3% 被运动员标记为伤病。三分之二的疼痛周（67.6%）未被标记为伤病，这表明仅依赖自报伤病会显著低估症状负担。
items.curatedReasonEn: This prospective cohort study highlights that relying solely on athlete-reported injuries misses a significant portion of pain issues. In your sports rehabilitation practice, you should use symptom- and consequence-based monitoring tools, such as the OSTRC questionnaire, to more comprehensively identify and manage athletes' health problems, rather than just waiting for them to report an 'injury'.
items.limitation: 本研究为观察性队列研究，不能建立因果关系，且研究人群仅限于意大利田径运动员，结果可能不完全适用于其他运动项目或人群。
items.limitationEn: This is an observational cohort study, which cannot establish causality. The study population is limited to Italian track-and-field athletes, so the results may not be fully generalizable to other sports or populations.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Validation study comparing a novel sham acupuncture technique with Park sham acupuncture: A randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=66) comparing a novel noninvasive sham acupuncture device with the Park sham device found no significant differences in perceived penetration sensation, pain, or deqi (p > 0.05). Both devices elicited minimal sensory responses (<1.0 on NRS), and the novel device was noninferior, supporting its use as a valid control in acupuncture trials.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 验证了一种新型假针刺设备的有效性，其与市售 Park 假针刺设备表现出可比的假性刺激效应，且未报告不良事件。这为针刺临床试验提供了另一个可信的对照工具，有助于未来更严谨的针刺疗效研究。
items.titleZh: 新型假针刺技术与 Park 假针刺比较的验证研究：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=66）比较了一种新型无创假针刺设备与 Park 假针刺设备，结果显示在感知穿透感、疼痛和得气方面无显著差异（p > 0.05）。两种设备均引起最小的感官反应（NRS <1.0），且新型设备具有非劣效性，支持其作为针刺试验的有效对照。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT validated a novel sham acupuncture device, demonstrating comparable sham stimulation effects to the commercially available Park sham acupuncture device, with no reported adverse events. This provides another credible control tool for acupuncture clinical trials, facilitating more rigorous research into acupuncture efficacy in the future.
items.limitation: 本研究的受试者是健康成人，结果可能无法直接外推至实际的疼痛或疾病患者群体。
items.limitationEn: The study participants were healthy adults, so the results may not be directly generalizable to actual pain or disease patient populations.

items.title: Patient Voices in a Digital Space: Thematic Analysis of YouTube Comments on Pelvic Floor Content
items.summary: A thematic analysis of 14.7K YouTube comments on pelvic floor physical therapy (PFPT) videos revealed three major themes: desire for community, healthcare experiences, and desire for knowledge. The platform serves as a vital resource for individuals with pelvic floor disorders, fostering community and empowerment.
items.curatedReason: YouTube 上的盆底物理治疗（PFPT）内容是患者获取信息和建立社区的重要渠道，尤其对于受耻辱感影响且难以获得传统医疗服务的患者。你可以利用这一趋势，加强线上患者教育和支持，但要注意内容的专业性和准确性。
items.titleZh: 数字空间中的患者声音：YouTube 盆底内容评论的主题分析
items.summaryZh: 对 YouTube 盆底物理治疗（PFPT）视频的 1.47 万条评论进行主题分析，发现三大主题：社区渴望、医疗经验和知识渴望。该平台是盆底功能障碍患者的重要资源，促进了社区建设和赋权。
items.curatedReasonEn: YouTube's pelvic floor physical therapy (PFPT) content serves as a vital resource for patients to access information and build community, especially for those affected by stigma and limited access to traditional healthcare. You can leverage this trend to enhance online patient education and support, but ensure the professionalism and accuracy of the content.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性定性分析，仅限于 YouTube 平台上的公开评论，可能无法全面反映所有患者的观点和体验。
items.limitationEn: This study is a retrospective qualitative analysis limited to public comments on YouTube, which may not fully reflect the views and experiences of all patients.

items.title: Trends in Australia's physiotherapy workforce: changes and future implications.
items.summary: Between 2013 and 2023, Australia's physiotherapy workforce increased by 70.5% to 35,889, yet 81.0% practiced in metropolitan areas, with males less likely and Indigenous physiotherapists more likely to work in regional, rural, and remote areas.
items.curatedReason: 澳大利亚物理治疗师劳动力分配不均问题依然突出，特别是城乡差距。报告提出的教育实践、激励和支持策略值得中国和美国PT行业思考，以解决偏远地区PT短缺问题。
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚物理治疗师劳动力趋势：变化与未来影响。
items.summaryZh: 2013年至2023年间，澳大利亚物理治疗师劳动力增长70.5%至35,889人，但81.0%仍在都市区执业，男性在城乡和偏远地区执业的可能性较低，而原住民物理治疗师则较高。
items.curatedReasonEn: Workforce maldistribution among Australian physiotherapists, especially between urban and rural areas, remains prominent. The strategies proposed, focusing on education, incentives, and support, are worth considering by the PT industries in China and the US to address PT shortages in remote areas.
items.limitation: 研究基于回顾性数据集，无法建立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: The study relies on retrospective datasets, which prevents establishing causal relationships.

items.title: Upper Limb Neurorehabilitation Using a Hybrid Technology-Enabled Therapy Approach-A Scoping Review.
items.summary: A scoping review identified ten studies on hybrid technology-enabled upper limb neurorehabilitation for adult stroke patients in hospital settings, showing positive outcomes and feasibility for implementation.
items.curatedReason: 本综述显示，针对中风患者的混合技术（如机器人、VR、传感器）上肢神经康复在医院环境中展现出积极效果和可行性。可作为你了解未来技术整合方向的参考。
items.titleZh: 使用混合技术实现的上肢神经康复方法：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项范围综述确定了针对住院成人中风患者使用混合技术（如机器人、虚拟现实和传感器疗法）进行上肢神经康复的十项研究，结果显示出积极的患者结局和临床实施的可行性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review indicates that hybrid technology (e.g., robotics, VR, sensor-based) for upper limb neurorehabilitation in stroke patients shows positive outcomes and feasibility in hospital settings. It serves as a reference for future technology integration trends.
items.limitation: 大多数研究为观察性或初步性质，侧重于临床可行性而非长期疗效。
items.limitationEn: Most studies were observational or pilot in nature, focusing on clinical feasibility rather than long-term efficacy.

items.title: Identifying key components for psychosocial interventions in neurorehabilitation: a realist evaluation on young adults with an acquired brain injury.
items.summary: A realist evaluation identified three key program theories for psychosocial interventions in young adults with acquired brain injury: engaging the individual, empowering the community, and equipping professionals.
items.curatedReason: 对于脑损伤年轻成人（含卒中）的心理社会干预，本研究提示有三大支柱：让个体参与、赋能社区、武装专业人员。如果你所在机构的康复方案效果不彰，不妨审视一下是否缺少这几个环节。
items.titleZh: 确定神经康复中心理社会干预的关键组成部分：一项针对获得性脑损伤年轻成人的真实主义评估
items.summaryZh: 一项真实主义评估确定了针对获得性脑损伤（包括中风）年轻成人进行心理社会干预的三个关键项目理论：个体参与、社区赋能和专业人员装备。
items.curatedReasonEn: For psychosocial interventions in young adults with acquired brain injury (including stroke), this study suggests three pillars: individual engagement, community empowerment, and equipping professionals. If your rehabilitation programs are falling short, consider whether these components are adequately addressed.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小，仅限于英国的年轻成人及服务提供者，可能影响结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The study involved a small sample size, limited to young adults and service providers in the UK, which may affect the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Motor memory consolidation during sleep after stroke: the rehabilitation timing hypothesis.
items.summary: This review synthesizes evidence for the rehabilitation timing hypothesis in stroke, suggesting that scheduling motor therapy close to sleep could enhance motor memory consolidation and recovery, though direct clinical evidence in stroke populations is lacking.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述提出了“康复时机假说”，强调将中风后运动康复安排在接近睡眠的时间，可能通过优化睡眠中的运动记忆巩固来增强恢复。这是一个值得你在临床实践中探索的低成本策略。
items.titleZh: 中风后睡眠期间运动记忆巩固：康复时机假说
items.summaryZh: 本综述综合了中风康复时机假说的证据，提出将运动疗法安排在临近睡眠的时间可能增强运动记忆巩固和恢复，尽管目前尚缺乏在卒中人群中直接验证的临床证据。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review introduces the "rehabilitation timing hypothesis," suggesting that scheduling post-stroke motor rehabilitation close to sleep may enhance recovery by optimizing motor memory consolidation during sleep. This is a low-cost strategy worth exploring in your clinical practice.
items.limitation: 目前在卒中人群中直接验证康复时机假说的临床证据尚缺乏，需要更多正式试验。
items.limitationEn: Direct clinical evidence to test the rehabilitation timing hypothesis in stroke populations is currently lacking, and more formal trials are urgently needed.
